newsitem.title: GERMANY: Tietmeyer rejects short-termist policy approach.
newsitem.headline: Tietmeyer rejects short-termist policy approach.

text.p: Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer on Monday rejected short-termist policies, saying that although continental Europe needed to become more flexible it was not right to exchange inflexibility for volatility.
In a speech congratulating Dutch central banker Wim Duisenberg on gaining a 'European Bank of the Year" award, Tietmeyer criticised the short-term aspect of U.K. policies.

Without naming Britain, Tietmeyer said, "There is an island in Europe. Some there sing the praises of a financial culture which seemingly is the only basis for the future. But this is in part very different from the continental financial culture."
